d: The Assistant Manager is responsible for serving customers on the shop floor and supporting the shop/department managers in ensuring efficient shop operations and maintaining high standards of customer service.
q: Minimum high school education or equivalent
2+ years of retail or equivalent management experience
r: li
Greet customers warmly and offer expert advice to assist in their purchase decisions, ensuring alignment with quality and customer service standards.
li
Assist the managers in maintaining inventories and placing product orders to ensure effective stock management and availability of products.
li
Report operational issues promptly and address customer complaints, providing solutions or escalating as needed to ensure both operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
li
Prepare detailed reports on key performance indicators (KPIs), sales trends, inventory status, and team productivity to keep managers informed and support effective decision-making.
li
Assist in scheduling staff to align efficiently with operational needs while optimizing costs for the shop/department.
li
Assign routine and non-routine tasks to sales associates, cashiers, and coordinators to optimize operational efficiency and ensure tasks are completed effectively.
li

Supervise the shop's opening and closing processes to ensure compliance with established procedures for petty cash, reporting, and other requirements. Ensure accurate delivery to the accounting department in accordance with company policies and security standards as necessary.
li

li

Assist in training, motivating, and evaluating the team to ensure that the necessary skill base is met, and that staff are optimally motivated and enabled to maximize their potential and contribution to the company.

d: We are looking for a highly talented Senior Android Engineer to join the team in Riyadh. If you are looking for a place where you can gain hands-on experience and create a direct impact, then this may be the place for you! An ideal candidate will have a track record as a significant individual contributor as well as a strong team player.
q: 5+ years of software development experience, with a strong foundation in design patterns and algorithms (Kotlin preferred, Java background accepted).
Technology-agnostic mindset with deep expertise in native Android development.
Hands-on experience delivering high-quality, testable code using modern mobile architectures.
In-depth understanding of the Android lifecycle (Activities, Fragments) and practical experience with Agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban).
Engineering excellence-a proven track record of driving significant impact on complex, non-trivial systems. Open-source contributions and technical publications are a strong plus.
Execution-driven mindset with strong project prioritization, multi-tasking abilities, and mastery of version control tools (Git).
Deep familiarity with Modern Android Development (MAD) practices and toolkits, including ViewModel, LiveData, Paging, Navigation, SafeArgs, Retrofit2, RxJava2, and multi-module Dagger2 setups.
Passion for elegant design and architectural modularization; experience with native iOS or Flutter is highly desirable.
Solid understanding of modular app architecture principles and CI/CD pipelines.
Ability to design and implement maintainable, scalable new modules.
Familiarity with AI tools, APIs, and machine learning integration within mobile applications.
Cross-platform versatility with hands-on experience in both Android and iOS ecosystems.
Nice to Have: Experience with Firebase, Google Maps API, Fastlane automation, and the Checkout.com SDK.

The Senior Manager – HR Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing key HR operational activities across Bahrain, with primary accountability for Payroll, Employee Relations, Union Relations, Compensation & Benefits, Employee Engagement, HR Service Quality and HR Governance.

The role leads the payroll team and ensures the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of payroll and related employee services, supported by effective controls, governance and reporting. The position is also responsible for managing day-to-day Employee Relations matters, including disciplinary and grievance cases, performance management, workplace concerns, investigations, employee welfare matters and other employee-related issues requiring HR intervention.

The role serves as a key interface between HR, management, employees and employee representatives, including the Trade Union, and is responsible for developing and maintaining constructive employee relations while ensuring the fair and consistent application of company policies, procedures, applicable employment requirements and organizational values.

In addition, the position supports compensation and benefits activities, employee engagement initiatives, Employee Opinion Surveys, HR quality surveys, workforce planning, organizational structure reviews, retention initiatives and HR reporting to ensure HR Operations effectively supports the organization’s people and business objectives.
Lead and oversee the end-to-end payroll operation for Bahrain, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing.
Manage, coach and develop the Payroll team, ensuring clear responsibilities, appropriate controls and consistently high service standards.
Ensure all salary changes, allowances, deductions, overtime, benefits and other payroll transactions are appropriately authorized, documented and accurately processed.
Maintain robust payroll controls, validation processes, reconciliation and governance standards.
Review payroll exceptions and discrepancies and ensure corrective action is completed in a timely manner.
Work closely with Finance, HR and other relevant stakeholders on payroll reconciliation, reporting and employee cost matters.
Ensure payroll records and employee information are properly maintained and treated
Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and approval controls throughout the payroll process.
Drive continuous improvement and process efficiency within payroll operations.
Support internal and external audits and ensure identified payroll-related findings are appropriately addressed.

Support the development, implementation and administration of compensation and benefits policies and procedures that are equitable, market-aligned and supportive of business objectives and employee retention.
Participate, where appropriate, in salary and benefits surveys and review relevant market salary information to support competitive compensation positioning.
Support annual compensation processes and year-end review activities.
Work with management to ensure appropriate incentive arrangements are in place and periodically review their effectiveness.
Recommend improvements to compensation, benefits or incentive arrangements where appropriate.
Ensure compensation and benefit practices are consistently administered and aligned with approved company frameworks and governance requirements.
Provide management with relevant compensation analysis and information to support decision-making.
Provide professional advice, support and guidance to managers and employees to maintain constructive and positive employee relations.
Identify and implement Employee Relations approaches appropriate to the Bahrain operational working environment.
Manage day-to-day ER matters including disciplinary cases, grievances, performance management, attendance, capability, welfare matters and workplace concerns.
Manage Employee Relations cases effectively, ensuring timely actions, appropriate documentation and consistent application of policies and procedures.
Conduct or support workplace investigations where required and ensure matters are assessed objectively and factually.
Coach and guide managers on disciplinary, grievance, capability, performance and other employee-related matters.
Resolve local employee issues independently where appropriate and escalate significant or high-risk matters when required.
Promote a fair and consistent application of organizational policies and procedures while minimizing Employee Relations risk.
Monitor the ER climate, identify emerging trends and undertake analysis to enable the business to take a more proactive approach to Employee Relations.
Monitor developments in employment practices and advise management on appropriate action where required.
Contribute to the development and implementation of Employee Relations strategy aligned with business requirements.
Lead the Employee Relations aspects of proposed organizational or structural changes and associated employee communications.
Work collaboratively with management and department heads to develop and implement initiatives supporting business strategy and employee effectiveness.
Act as a key HR point of contact for relations with the recognized Trade Union and employee representatives.
Establish and maintain professional, constructive and transparent relationships with union representatives.
Manage and coordinate the HR response to employee matters and concerns raised through the union.
Participate in meetings with union representatives and provide management with appropriate HR guidance and support.
Ensure union-related concerns are appropriately reviewed, documented and responded to in a timely and professional manner.
Support consultation and dialogue on workplace matters affecting employees and the organization.
Maintain accurate documentation relating to union discussions, correspondence, commitments and follow-up actions.
Monitor the overall union relations climate and identify potential issues requiring proactive management attention.
Facilitate constructive dialogue between employees, employee representatives and management and support the appropriate resolution of workplace disputes.
Voice of Employee and Employee Engagement
Regularly capture and assess the Voice of Employees through employee meetings, focus groups, engagement sessions and survey activities.
Identify perceived areas requiring improvement and develop appropriate solutions and follow-up actions to strengthen employee relations and engagement.
Provide thorough analysis of employee feedback and present key findings and relevant highlights to senior management.
Support managers in developing and implementing action plans in response to employee feedback.
Manage employee recognition and suggestion schemes aimed at improving employee engagement and organizational performance.
Coach and support managers in facilitating Active Leadership Workshops, performance dialogues, improvement workshops, team-building sessions and other engagement activities.
Support initiatives designed to strengthen organizational culture, communication, retention and the overall employee experience.
Conduct exit interviews for employees leaving the organization, including resignations and retirements, and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities.
Plan, communicate, manage and support the full annual Employee Opinion Survey process for Bahrain entities.
Coordinate survey communication and participation activities in cooperation with relevant HR and business stakeholders.
Analyze survey results and provide meaningful summaries and key findings to management.
Support management and HR stakeholders in developing appropriate follow-up and improvement plans.
Monitor agreed actions to ensure identified improvement priorities are appropriately followed through.
